algo_characteristics.algorand_mechanics_notes: ALGO (Algorand) specific FR mechanics: 1. Pure PoS participation: all ALGO holders may participate via VRF sortition. Participation rewards REMOVED 2023 — previously paid 5-6% APY → now zero. This compressed speculative long demand vs BTC (less reason to hold ALGO for yield). 2. Enterprise/CBDC focus: CBDC pilots (Nigeria eNaira launched on Algorand, Marshall Islands SOV), TradFi tokenization (institutional asset issuance). FR spikes driven by CBDC announcement events and institutional partnership news. 3. ARC standards (Algorand Request for Comment): enterprise token standards drive periodic demand for ALGO as gas → idiosyncratic FR spikes vs BTC. 4. State proofs: succinct proofs enable cross-chain state verification → increasingly used for institutional bridge infrastructure → enterprise flow. 5. Governance votes: quarterly periods where committed ALGO earns governance rewards. Quarterly lock-up periods create seasonal FR patterns (commitment deadlines). 6. Carbon-negative certification: Algorand + ClimateTrade carbon offset integration → ESG narrative cycles (less crypto-native, more institutional cycle correlated). 7. HL maxLeverage=5 (lowest tier): suggests lower liquidity / trading activity on HL vs BTC (maxLev=50) → FR more volatile on limited HL flow.
